title: Randomized average block coordinate descent method with heavy-ball momentum for tensor least squares problem under the t-product
summary: A tensor randomized average block coordinate descent method with heavy-ball momentum is proposed for the tensor least squares problem with respect to the t-product. Theoretical analysis for tensor block coordinate descent method is established and average techniques are applied to avoid the computation of tensor Moore--Penrose inverse. To further accelerate convergence, a heavy-ball momentum scheme is incorporated into the block coordinate descent method, where the step size and momentum parameters are adaptively determined by a two-dimensional minimal residual projection.
